title: Stage C3: 120 s run with framebuffer recording — confirm visible iOS pixels
acceptance: loader-diag-xnu-sc3-md1 image built, hashes pinned in evidence
loader oem-recording path implemented and host-tested
Single authorized run: kernel runs for 120 s, loader_return_after fires, recording extracted
Recording contains at least one frame with non-zero pixels (direct pixel evidence)
Stock RECOVERY restored, SHA-256 verified, Android boot confirmed
run-001/report.json and evidence.json saved with all provenance
steps: Implement oem recording download in e1s loader shim (adds USB bulk-IN for recording buffer)
Add rec_secs=30 rec_mb=64 rec_ring=1 to kernel cmdline; remove serial=3 keepsyms=1 fb_diff=1; set loader_return_after=120
Build loader-diag-xnu-sc3-md1; verify cmdline <= 256 B; run host tests
Draft and obtain owner decision for one native run
Execute run, extract recording, convert with tools/recording.py, verify pixels
Restore stock RECOVERY unconditionally, verify Android
notes: cpus=1 means loader pauses Samsung S5E9945 WDT before jumping to kernel — no hardware watchdog during kernel run, 120 s is safe. Recording extracted via new oem-recording USB path after loader_return. rec_mb=64 fits ~7 full 1125x2436 BGRA frames; rec_ring=1 keeps last 7. cmdline budget: 252 bytes.
